mobile.projects.create.description.note: Label for an optional project description.

mobile.projects.create.description_place.note: Placeholder prompting an optional project description.

mobile.projects.create.name.note: Label for the project identifier field; the nearby help states its grammar.

mobile.projects.create.name_placeholder.note: Example of a valid project identifier; preserve the hyphen and use only letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen, never starting with a hyphen.

mobile.projects.create.status.note: Label for the project status choices.

mobile.projects.create.tags_help.note: Explains how to separate multiple project tags.

mobile.projects.create.tags_placeholder.note: Examples of two tags, separated by a comma; use valid short tag examples.

mobile.projects.create.title.note: Title of the sheet for creating a project.

mobile.projects.delete_body.note: Destructive confirmation. Placeholder {name} is the project's display name (user text, may contain spaces). Both halves are load-bearing: what the delete destroys and what it leaves alone.

mobile.projects.draft_kept_note.note: Tells the reader a dismissed form kept their unfinished work and how to discard it. Applies to both the create sheet and the milestone editor.

mobile.projects.milestone_slash_note.note: Explains why a milestone name may not contain a slash. Names the consequence the reader can act on; never mention routes, paths or encoding.

mobile.projects.milestones.count.note: Milestone progress from the relay's own two counts. {completed} and {total} are non-negative integers and both must survive translation. ENGLISH needs no plural agreement because its noun is fixed to the count phrase; a locale whose noun agrees with the completed count must pluralize on {completed} (French: one/many/other) and keep {total} a plain placeholder inside every branch — the generator fails a translation that drops or retypes either name.

mobile.projects.milestones.none.note: Lower-case fragment shown where a milestone count would go when the relay reports zero total milestones. It is joined with a session count, so it carries no final full stop.

mobile.projects.project_name_hint.note: The complete project-name grammar stated before the tap. Length range and allowed characters must stay exact: this sentence is the reader's only warning before a refusal.

mobile.projects.remove_milestone_body.note: Destructive confirmation. Placeholder {name} is the milestone name (user text, may contain spaces). Says what goes and what stays.

mobile.projects.session_state.filed_by.note: Lower-case two-word fragment marking a coordination row: the session filed the work rather than doing it. Never imply the row is a worker.

mobile.projects.session_state.missing.note: Lower-case word for a linked session whose directory is gone. The link is still listed; this names its state.

mobile.projects.session_state.not_runnin.note: Lower-case replacement for the relay's 'stopped' runtime state. The ordinary end of a session, not an error.

mobile.projects.sessions.count.note: Session count. {count} is a non-negative integer and drives the plural category; # is that number. The zero case is 'other' in English.

mobile.projects.sessions.live.note: Appends the live-session count to a session-count phrase. {base} is the already-rendered count phrase; {live} is a positive integer. Shown only when at least one session is live.

mobile.projects.stale_badge.note: One badge word pair naming WHAT is stale (progress) rather than the project. Lower case; it sits beside a project name.

mobile.projects.status.active.note: Display label for the project status code active; translate the label, not the underlying code. Shown in the create sheet as a selectable chip.

mobile.projects.status.archived.note: Display label for the project status code archived; translate the label, not the underlying code. Shown in the create sheet as a selectable chip.

mobile.projects.status.done.note: Display label for the project status code done; translate the label, not the underlying code. Shown in the create sheet as a selectable chip.

mobile.projects.status.paused.note: Display label for the project status code paused; translate the label, not the underlying code. Shown in the create sheet as a selectable chip.

mobile.projects.status.planning.note: Display label for the project status code planning; translate the label, not the underlying code. Shown in the create sheet as a selectable chip.

mobile.projects.status.qa.note: Display label for the project status code qa; translate the label, not the underlying code. Shown in the create sheet as a selectable chip.

mobile.projects.status.validation.note: Display label for the project status code validation; translate the label, not the underlying code. Shown in the create sheet as a selectable chip.

mobile.projects.write_receipt.note: One-line success receipt. THREE PARAMETERS, all supplied by the screen: {action} is a stable CODE (created, completed, reopened, added, updated, removed, deleted) and never a rendered word — the catalogue turns it into the verb; {subject} is the BARE NAME of the thing acted on (user text, never a phrase such as 'milestone X', because a phrase composed in one language cannot be ordered or inflected by another); {kind} is a stable CODE for WHAT the subject names (project, milestone, other). Each locale supplies its own noun and its own word order — English verb-first, French naming the thing first with the participle last — which is why the action arms are repeated inside every kind arm: a locale has to be free to move the verb. other catches an unknown kind or an unknown action code. Ends with a full stop.

mobile.projects.write_unknown_note.note: Shown when a write got no answer. Must state that the outcome is UNKNOWN, never that nothing was saved.

mobile.projects.title.note: Screen title of the projects list (navigation bar). One word, ~16 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.section.progress.note: Lower-case section heading on a project's detail screen, above its latest progress line. Lower case is the house style for these detail headings; follow your language's equivalent. ~16 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.section.milestones.note: Lower-case section heading on a project's detail screen, above its milestone list. ~16 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.section.linked_sessions.note: Lower-case section heading on a project's detail screen, above the conversations linked to it ('sessions' = conversations). ~20 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.list.load_failed.note: Error alert on the Projects list when the computer could not be reached; a Try again button follows. One sentence, plain and blameless. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.empty.headline.note: Empty-state headline on the Projects list when the computer has no projects. Short sentence, keep under ~32 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.empty.next.note: Empty-state second line on the Projects list. {action} is the header button label (mobile.projects.create.title, "New project") so the sentence and the button never drift; keep it as a quoted-or-plain button name in your grammar. One sentence.

mobile.projects.detail.gone.note: Error shown on Project detail when the project was deleted or renamed elsewhere (a 404). One sentence. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.detail.title_fallback.note: Screen title on Project detail while the project is still loading, before its name is known. One word, keep under ~16 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.detail.load_failed.note: Error alert on Project detail when the computer could not be reached; a Try again button follows. One sentence, blameless. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.detail.milestones_empty.note: Muted line under the milestones section heading of Project detail when the project has none. Short sentence, keep under ~24 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.detail.sessions_empty.note: Muted line under the linked sessions section heading of Project detail when no conversation is linked. Short sentence, keep under ~28 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.detail.delete.note: Destructive button at the foot of Project detail AND the title of the confirm dialog it opens; both must read the same. Keep under ~24 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.detail.delete_confirm.note: Destructive confirm button in the Delete project dialog. One verb, keep under ~12 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.add.note: Button on Project detail that opens the milestone editor, AND that editor sheet's title when adding. Keep under ~24 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.edit_title.note: Title of the milestone editor sheet when editing an existing milestone. Keep under ~24 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.add_submit.note: Submit button in the milestone editor when adding a new milestone (editing uses the shared Save). One verb, keep under ~12 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.remove.note: Destructive button in the milestone editor AND the title of the confirm dialog it opens; both must read the same. Keep under ~24 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.remove_confirm.note: Destructive confirm button in the Remove milestone dialog. One verb, keep under ~12 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.name.note: Field label for the milestone name in the milestone editor. The name is the milestone's key. One word. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.name_placehold.note: Placeholder example of a milestone name in the milestone editor: a short lowercase example of a project phase, translated naturally (it is an example, not an identifier). Keep under ~20 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.target_date.note: Field label for the milestone's optional due date in the milestone editor. Keep under ~20 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.target_date_pl.note: Input-mask hint for the target date field. The field only accepts ISO 8601 (year-month-day, digits, hyphens), so keep the order year, month, day and the hyphens; translate only the letters if your language abbreviates year/month/day differently. Keep 10 characters. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.target_date_he.note: Help line under the target date field explaining how to remove a due date. One sentence. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.reopen_hint.note: Screen-reader hint on a completed milestone's checkbox row: what activating it does. Third-person present, no final period (platform hint convention). No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.complete_hint.note: Screen-reader hint on an open milestone's checkbox row: what activating it does. Third-person present, no final period. No placeholders.

mobile.projects.milestone.edit_label.note: Screen-reader name of the pencil button beside a milestone. {name} is the milestone's own name (user data, never translated). Keep the placeholder. Short.
